title: Partner program
subtitle: Recommend DaleControl to another barbershop and earn a commission once they start paying.

blocker.schemaMissingTitle: The affiliates SQL hasn't been applied
blocker.schemaMissingBody: The program's tables don't exist in the database yet. Apply sql/barber_afiliados.sql in Supabase and this screen turns on by itself. Nothing else in the panel is affected in the meantime.
blocker.disabledBody: No new commissions are being generated right now. What you already earned is still on record.
blocker.lockedTitle: Your plan doesn't include the partner program
blocker.lockedBody: Switch plans to start earning for every barbershop you recommend.

link.title: Your link
link.body: Share it on WhatsApp, put it in your bio or stick the QR on the counter. Whoever comes in through it stays linked to you for {days} days, even if they sign up later.
link.qrBody: Any barber can scan it with their phone camera.

terms.title: How it pays
terms.onetime: You earn {amount} for every barbershop you recommend, the first time they pay.
terms.recurring: You earn {amount} every month the barbershop you recommended keeps paying.
terms.recurringCapped: You earn {amount} a month for every barbershop you recommend, up to {months} months.
terms.whenBody: The commission shows up when the barbershop you recommended activates its subscription, not when it signs up.
terms.holdBody: Each commission becomes available {days} days after it's generated. That's the margin in case of a refund.
terms.payBody: Once you have an available balance we deposit it and the receipt stays here, in your commission list.

funnel.title: Your funnel
funnel.clicksHelp: Unique visits. Reloads and bots don't count.
funnel.signupsHelp: Opened their account with your link.
funnel.payingHelp: These are the ones earning you a commission.
funnel.empty: Nobody has come in through your link yet. Send it to a couple of people in the trade and you'll see it move here.

earnings.title: What you've earned
earnings.pendingHelp: On hold. It releases on its own.
earnings.paidHelp: With its receipt in the list.
earnings.belowMin: You need {amount} more in available balance to reach the payout minimum.
earnings.readyToPay: You've reached the minimum: we'll reach out to deposit it.

referrals.title: Barbershops you recommended
referrals.empty: Barbershops that sign up with your link will show up here.

commissions.title: Your commissions
commissions.empty: No commissions yet. They're generated when a barbershop you recommended starts paying.

share.title: Ready to send
share.body: Copy the message or download the image and send them on WhatsApp as they are.
share.whatsappText: Hey, I run my barbershop on DaleControl: the calendar, the walk-in queue and the cash count in one app. If you want to try it, come in through here: {url}
share.imageBody: It carries your QR and your code. Looks good as a WhatsApp status.
share.imageAlt: Shareable image with the QR for {shop}

payout.title: Where we deposit
payout.body: Leave us your details and we'll use them when it's time to pay you. You can change them anytime.
payout.detailsPlaceholder: Account number, bank and account holder

claim.title: Did someone recommend you?
claim.body: If another barbershop gave you their code and it wasn't registered when you signed up, type it here.
